name: Ego4D: Massive-Scale Egocentric Video Benchmark
description: Ego4D is a massive-scale egocentric video dataset and benchmark suite created by a consortium of 13 academic institutions and Meta AI. It comprises 3,670 hours of daily-life activity video recorded from a first-person viewpoint across 74 locations in 9 countries by 931 participants wearing wearable cameras (GoPro, camera glasses). Ego4D defines five benchmark tasks: Episodic Memory, Hands and Objects, Forecasting, Audio-Visual Diarization, and Social Interaction, providing multimodal annotations including 3D meshes, gaze tracking, narration streams, and stereo audio.
